CONTROLS.NAME: auto_jumper
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically jumps to a new background location on percussive beats. Turn off for full manual control.

CONTROLS.NAME: jump
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Press to manually jump to a new background location.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically pulses on bass hits. Turn off for full manual control.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Press to manually create a pulse.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Control the intensity of the pulse. Lower for subtle, high for a lot of motion.

CONTROLS.NAME: contrast
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn on to increase contrast. Less uniform and more distinct dots. Try with pulse intensity on high and slices ON.

CONTROLS.NAME: slices
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Slices up the screen. Turn on, then turn pulse intensity up for a cool splitting effect.
